notes: The primary button has its gold fill back. The theme was styling two button names the app no longer uses, so none of its button styling reached them — and its general button rule then overrode the app's own. 83 out-of-date names in the…

Buttons were 19 pixels tall — the height of their text and nothing more, because the theme removes the padding and expects a height that was never applied. Buttons now have a floor, set from the height the theme itself asks for.

Machine names like ASUSTeK and ROG Zephyrus were rendering in a typewriter face. That value style was defined twice in our own design system, disagreeing, and the second one won. It is one definition now, on the reading face.
Tier descriptions were set at label size. They are body size now — the contrast was always fine, which is why nothing flagged it.
